steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Running stitch and back stitch are basic construction stitches; chain, satin and French knots are decorative stitches with distinct visual qualities. | Key Fact: Free-motion machine embroidery drops the feed dogs, allowing you to draw with thread — it requires practice to control speed and direction. | Key Fact: Appliqué attaches fabric shapes to a background fabric — it can be fused, pinned or stitched in place before edge-stitching. | Key Fact: Patchwork and piecing join fabric pieces edge-to-edge; accuracy in cutting and seam allowance is essential for flat, even results.
